hero.title: Stop losing jobs because the phone doesn't get answered
hero.subtitle: You know the feeling: you're in the middle of a job and the phone rings. If you answer it, you lose focus. If you don't, you risk losing a good job. It's an impossible situation.

solution.title: Never miss a job again
solution.description: Our AI receptionist solves this problem once and for all. The system answers every call, records customer details, books site visits and sends automatic confirmations via SMS. In your dashboard you can see every enquiry, listen to recorded conversations, get short summaries of what the customer wants, and see what's been agreed. Your calendar updates automatically, no matter which system you use. Stop worrying about missed jobs – focus on your craft.
